thread:
Carmen: Quick postmortem follow-up — we keep seeing EOD bursts that drive GPU headroom under 8% for ~5-12m. I captured the immediate actions below, can owners ack and add timelines?

Evan: Ack. I can take scheduler tuning items.

Julia: Thanks Carmen — adding infra notes: burst pattern looks like 18:45-19:05 UTC, correlated with batch rerank jobs and a weekly customer leaderboard job.

Suresh: @Evan for scheduler: I think packing/eviction windows need review. Current packing policy 'spread-v1' seems to underutilize on short bursts.

Evan: Agreed. Proposed changes: shorten preemption scan to 30s, bump pack threshold to 0.6 for GPU pools, and add a soft-quota backstop for dedicated customers.

Ryan: I'll own the quota backstop work. Plan: add soft quota (grace queue) that absorbs short spikes and emits telemetry. Owner: Ryan, ETA: 2026-04-08.

Lia: I'll create a small eval set to detect regression after tuning. Also recommend a canary for the scheduler change. Owner: Lia, ETA: 2026-04-04.

Carmen: Nice. Suresh — can you draft the scheduler config diff and a runbook step for rollback? Owner: Suresh, ETA: 2026-04-03.

Suresh: Yup. Draft will include this snippet for the packing policy switch:
```
# change packing policy
scheduler.packing.policy: "pack-v2"
scheduler.packing.threshold: 0.6
scheduler.preemption.scan_interval_s: 30
```
I'll post PR and a perf baseline.

Evan: For safety, add automatic fallback: if avg headroom < 5% for 3 consecutive 1-min windows, revert to previous policy automatically. I'll add that check to the operator job.

ops-bot: alert: gpu-headroom-drop triggered 2026-03-18T18:48:12Z — peak utilization 98% (15 min) :warning:

Carmen: Good call. Ryan — please wire the alert to a different channel for quota hits so we can distinguish infra vs customer quota.

Ryan: Will do. Also adding a metric tag 'soft_quota_consumed' to help triage.

Julia: Two follow-ups: (1) schedule a weekly postmortem digest for recurring patterns, (2) add a short-term cap on rerank batch concurrency during EOD window. Owner: Julia for digest (ETA 2026-04-06), Owner: Product for rerank cap (TBD).

Lia: Canary plan: deploy scheduler change to a 10% subset of GPU nodes for 24h, run eval set, compare p50/p95 latency and token cost. If p95 regresses >10% rollback.

Evan: I'll coordinate the canary and add the automatic fallback.

Carmen: Action summary (short):
- Scheduler tuning PR (Suresh) — 2026-04-03
- Canary + auto-fallback (Evan) — 2026-04-05
- Soft-quota/grace queue (Ryan) — 2026-04-08
- Eval + regression checks (Lia) — 2026-04-04
- Weekly recurring-pattern digest (Julia) — 2026-04-06

Carmen: Please react with :white_check_mark: when you accept your action or add a comment if dates don't work.

Suresh: :white_check_mark:

Evan: :white_check_mark: I'll post the canary playbook by EOD tomorrow.

Ryan: :white_check_mark: Adjusting backlog, will ping infra owners for alert routing.

Lia: :white_check_mark: I'll add the eval harness and expected failure modes.

Julia: :white_check_mark: I'll set up the weekly digest channel and subscribe alerts.

Carmen: Thanks everyone. I'll close this loop in the remediation tracker after PRs and canary pass.

Evan: One more note — we should track incident recurrence rate over 30d to see if changes reduce frequency. Adding to tracking doc.

Julia: Agreed. Also tagging impacted customer list for outreach if we see repeated SLA hits.

Carmen: Closing for now — reopen thread if blockers appear. :thumbsup:
